{{Expand Russian|topic=bio|date=November 2022}}

'''Viktoria Moiseyevna "Vika" Siradze''' ({{langx|ka|ვიქტორია "ვიკა" სირაძე}}; {{langx|ru|Викто́рия Моисе́евна Сира́дзе}}; 27 May 1929, [[Tbilisi]] – 22 February 2024)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nplg.gov.ge/bios/ka/00011837/|title=ვიკა სირაძე|language=ka|work=Georgian Biographical Dictionary|access-date=6 February 2025}}</ref> was a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] politician. She was a deputy in the [[Supreme Soviet of the Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic]] from 1955 to 1962 and 1967 to 1989.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://ipress.ge/news/sazogadoeba/94-tslis-asakshi-viqtoria-siradze-gardaitsvala|title=94 წლის ასაკში ვიქტორია სირაძე გარდაიცვალა|language=ka|work=iPress|date=22 February 2024}}</ref> She was appointed [[Deputy prime minister|Deputy Prime Minister]] of the [[Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic]] in 1962.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.guide2womenleaders.com/Georgia.htm|title = Georgia Ministers}}</ref>
